اكفهررت (form IVq)
# اِكْفَهْرَرْتُ (ikfahrartu) /ik.fah.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# اِكْفَهْرَرْتَ (ikfahrarta) /ik.fah.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# اِكْفَهْرَرْتِ (ikfahrarti) /ik.fah.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
